title: People at Lake Washing Hair with Canoe, 1945 Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1945 snapshot featuring people near a canoe at the edge of a serene pond or lake. One person leans over to wash or assist another in the water, matching the note on the back that asks Shampoo?. The setting is surrounded by evergreen trees, conveying a calm outdoor leisure scene from the summer of 1945.
